description: This Java source file defines the GatewayConnector class which handles HTTP connections to the eWay payment gateway. It provides methods to configure timeout settings and to send requests (GatewayRequest) and receive responses (GatewayResponse).

classes.name: GatewayConnector
classes.description: Handles HTTP communication with the eWay payment gateway, including setting timeouts, sending requests, and receiving responses.

methods.name: GatewayConnector
